# Switch NX2 - read when the Eglantine GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eglantine\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eglantine/nx2_switches.txt; in a portable build user\nx2_switches.txt, or
# user/config/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to a second (back) thread.
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# buffers the CPU never touches, which adds mutex contention and lowers FPS (upstream reported a
# large drop; not measured in this fork).
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Speed experiment (0.5, not released) ---
# Off by default and unmeasured. Read once when it is first needed. Values: 1 turns it on; unset or
# any other value leaves it off.

# The shader precache build also reads the add-on packages of a .nup (Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Switch 2
# Edition keeps its game data there). Rebuild the precache after changing it.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_ADDON=1

# Attribution of long frames (over 100 ms) and of the first minutes to causes (disk, shader
# compilation, translation, decompression, waits), written into the run report. On by default;
# 0 turns it off and the report then says so.
#EDEN_NX2_ATTRIBUTION=0

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can lower FPS: upstream reported a
# drop in Mario Kart World; not measured in this fork).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

# EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH is kept from upstream's file; this fork's source does not read it.
#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- Test switches (for unattended-run tests; never set these in normal use) ---
# Crash the emulator on purpose after N presented frames (a null write on the thread that presents).
# Used to test that a crash during a scripted run (eden-cli --report ...) leaves a report with
# exit.reason "host_crash" and the process exit code 73. Off unless set.
#EDEN_NX2_TEST_CRASH_AFTER_FRAMES=300

# A control directory for unattended-run tests (tools/nx2/shader_lab.py). The emulator writes
# <dir>/session.txt (the title id and a nonce of this run) there and reads the interactive marker
# "interactive <scene> <pass|fail> <title id> <nonce> [<origin>]" from <dir>/keys.txt.
#EDEN_NX2_DIAG_DIR=C:\path\to\dir
